$comment: Design inspiration library: the design language of 100 of the world's most famous apps. These are descriptions of publicly observable design patterns and color directions for INSPIRATION - color palettes and layout patterns are free to draw from, but never copy logos, trademarks, brand assets, proprietary illustrations or exact trade dress.
